Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three

Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.2 Comprehension

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What do you think will happen in the story? 2. What do you think we shall learn from the story?
